m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Cyrus Drake sent you for a spell? Haven't the Drakes meddled enough in the affairs of Dragonspyre?
Enough, though. I cannot provide you with such a spell, because I don't have it any more! It was taken by the Hoarder!
Who's that? You don't know? The Hoarder is Morganthe's most devout follower, hoarding magic in hope of her return!
The Hoarder took many spells from the Atheneum, including yours, and keeps them within a tower in the Plaza of Conquests.
If you wish that spell, you must defeat the Hoarder and take the Basilisk spell from the Hoarder's Books of Myth. Good luck!
You certainly took your time. Stopped for a nap, did you?
Now we shall turn to the more practical matter of procuring you the means to apply your knowledge.
You must now learn to summon the Basilisk, bringing it forth to dismay and befuddle your foes with the force of its gaze.
However, you must work for such power. The spell is not at my disposal to provide you. It lies in Dragonspyre, home to the Dragon!
Go speak to Milos Bookwyrm in the Atheneum. He will give you the means of summoning the Basilisk, or put you on the right path!
Venture to the Atheneum in Dragonspyre, and learn to summon the Basilisk from Milos Bookwyrm. Only he holds that knowledge!
